my_lead: 9f - abstract: highest COX-2 inhibition, most potent cytotoxicity on MCF-7 (0.03 uM), used for apoptosis/Bax/Bcl-2/docking/MD

reactions.issue: Oxone supplies the oxygens, appropriately unlisted

Hydroxylamine hydrochloride is labelled origin 'reagent' with SMILES NO; it supplies N and O of the oxime, so it is a real reactant (commercial). NaOH is a base and correctly omitted. Oxime 8f yield 57% per 4.1.11.
NaOCl (oxidant for in-situ nitrile oxide) correctly unlisted. 2.5 equiv oxime used but incorporated once.

leaf_issues: Indanone (3) and 4-methylthiobenzaldehyde (4) are not named in a supplier sentence; support is 'Most of the reagents were obtained from Sigma-Aldrich or Merck ... All commercially available materials, including compounds 7a-7g, were used without further purification' plus no preparation anywhere. 3,4-Dimethoxybenzaldehyde (7f) is explicitly commercial.
notes: 4 reactions (longest chain 3: 5 -> 6 -> 9f; oxime 8f is a parallel one-step branch). Paper says 9f and 9g 'were reported previously (ref 26)' but gives the full procedure here (4.1.13, 9f entry: 42%, mp 160-162 C). Target SMILES checked: spiro carbon bonded to ring O, CH2 and C=O of the indanone (spiro[indene-2,5'-isoxazol]-1(3H)-one), C3' carries 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl and C=N, C4' carries 4-MeSO2C6H4; matches the isoxazolin H4' singlet at 5.00 and the formula C26H23NO6S. Regiochemistry rests on the printed name (no drawn structure in the text). Racemic, no stereo stated.
